name: carwhere-vin
description: Decode any US-market VIN, check open NHTSA safety recalls, and look up verified buyer-paid car prices. Real transaction data, not estimates. Free, no API key. Built by CarWhere; includes one clearly labeled paid tool, buy_vin_report, which creates a Stripe checkout link for CarWhere's $9.99 Full VIN Report. Free tools return data with source attribution only.
